notes: Medium (total 13). Five independent numeric kernels, each with an exact, verifier-recomputed contract. (1) A hand-written RK4 integrator for dy/dt=-c*y with a library denylist check (no scipy.integrate/optimize/solve_ivp/odeint) plus numeric agreement with the analytic e^{-ct} (quantitative=3). (2) An adaptive smooth-blend of a strictly-positive distribution toward uniform until BOTH forward KL(q||p) and reverse KL(p||q) drop under given radii, returning a valid positive, unit-sum array verified against an independent dense reference (RL and undercount/miscount edges). (3) scipy.signal.stft at documented fixed parameters over provided signals, exporting linear (not dB) magnitudes; the magnitudes are compared exact allclose to a fresh identical scipy call on each hidden signal, and /app/out.npy is checked byte-equal to that computation for the visible sine-sum. (4) per-round accuracy that drops invalid and unmatched pairs, correct/total with half-up to 3 decimals and null accuracy when no valid pairs (adversarial=2). (5) a symbolic sympy integrand/interval that sp.integrate evaluates to the exact Rational(1,n+1) (no floating decimal). Reasoning comes from deriving the adaptive-KL schedule and the ODE/generalization; hidden cases exercise different degrees, radii sizes (including zero radii and length-1), unmatched/error-dense rounds, and dissimilar signal/NFFT settings, so hardcoding any visible value is impossible.
